column1: Spread the tomatoes, onion, habanero and pineapple on a sheet pan, season with salt and mist with oil if desired.
Roast about 30 minutes until the vegetables char at the edges and the pineapple caramelizes.
Transfer the roasted produce to a food processor or blender with the garlic, lime juice and cilantro.
Blend to your preferred texture, avoiding large chunks of habanero, then season with salt and serve.
